source_event.reason: The independent re-audit stopped at remediation preflight because the latest independent rejection was recorded in learning-closure but had no explicit matching entry in the cumulative audit-escape ledger.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A remediation packet records an independent rejection in learning metadata while validators inspect only escape entries that are already present, allowing an omitted rejection to pass producer readiness.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate each existing escape entry and historical monotonicity without comparing the set of known independent rejection identifiers against the set represented by the cumulative escape ledger.

reusable_control.rule: Cross-check each current independent rejection identifier and declared finding identifiers against explicit passed entries in the cumulative escape ledger before handoff or re-audit.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The producer must assign a stable rejection identifier and fail handoff readiness when that rejection or any declared finding is absent from the cumulative escape ledger.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The independent auditor must repeat the rejection-to-ledger set comparison before broad re-audit and stop as remediation-incomplete when coverage is missing.

transfer_cases.scenario: Learning records a new independent rejection while the escape ledger contains only historical entries.
A rejection is present in the ledger but one declared finding identifier is omitted from all matching entries.

source_event.reason: The independent audit found the published PR head had moved materially beyond the certified handoff child, so the existing certificate no longer represented the current candidate.

generalized_learning.reason: The failure is an execution-specific miss of the already-versioned universal post-write-refreeze and terminal-handoff rules in entregar-issue. The generic prevention and detection contracts already require material drift to invalidate the previous certificate and require a direct allowlisted result-only child before audit readiness.

source_event.reason: The audit rejected the delivery because quantitative performance evidence was measured on an ancestor SHA and promoted to the final material head by structural reasoning.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A measured quantitative result is associated with a later material identity even though that later identity was never the subject of the measurement.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: After any material change, retain earlier benchmark percentiles and relabel metadata as if the measurement belonged to the new candidate.

reusable_control.rule: Require a normalized evidence subject identity and reject quantitative evidence unless it equals the frozen material candidate.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Invalidate quantitative exact-subject evidence after any material change and reexecute the measurement on the new material candidate before freeze.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Cross-check normalized subject identity and raw quantitative result identity against the certified material candidate before accepting the handoff.

transfer_cases.scenario: An ancestor latency benchmark is presented for a later material candidate.
An ancestor memory or cardinality measurement is presented for a later material candidate.
